summary: Traduora is a self-hosted translation-management web app (NestJS + TypeORM REST API). Users own Projects; each project groups Terms (keys) and Locales; the Translation matrix holds one value per (term,locale). Labels annotate terms/translations; ProjectUsers/ProjectClients carry per-project roles; work proceeds through invites, plans (string quotas), and file import/export.
